preconditions.description: The number of operations n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= i - 1 for i, k in enumerate(k_values, start=1))
preconditions.description: For each operation i, the number of edges k is between 0 and i-1 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vj <= i - 1 for i, k_values in enumerate(input_operations, start=1) for k in range(k_values[0]) for vj in k_values[2*k+1::2])
preconditions.description: For each edge in operation i, the target vertex vj is between 1 and i-1 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(-1000000000 <= xj <= 1000000000 for k_values in input_operations for xj in k_values[2::2])
preconditions.description: For each edge in operation i, the weight xj is between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.
The total number of edges added across all operations does not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.description: The result is between 0 and 1,000,000,007 exclusive.
The result is the sum of the weights of all edges in the forest modulo 1,000,000,007.
